text: C0[p10, p12, p20, m1^2, m2^2, m3^2] is the scalar Passarino-Veltman \(C_0\) function. The convention for the arguments is that if the denominator of the integrand has the form \(([q^2-m1^2] [(q+p1)^2-m2^2] [(q+p2)^2-m3^2])\), the first three arguments of C0 are the scalar products \(p10 = p1^2\), p12 = (p1-p2).(p1-p2), p20 = p2^2.
